name: Miami
summary: Miami combines a beach atmosphere, a vibrant Latin and international culture and one of the fastest growing financial and technological hubs in the United States. Its time zone coincides with much of Latin America, which makes remote work easier with that region, although the cost of living is high by American standards and it is worth taking into account the hurricane season.
